description: List a trail's plan revisions. Every approved revision of the trail's plan, newest first: the plan as it was approved, who approved it and when, and what changed since the revision before. A plan is revised by a `replan` run, which re-reads the goal metric, the items' outcomes and project memory and drafts …

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

name: trails_plan_revisions
